content: {"episode_id":"ep-05054","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229), acknowledging that prior authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent syncope and near-syncope associated with palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia. Given the intermittent symptoms and the need for continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture potential arrhythmic events."}
